## Requirements: Claude Code App-first workspace composition

### Problem / baseline (2026-11-17)
Current `web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/ClaudeCodeWorkspace.tsx` renders the same five top-level tabs (Conversations / Transcripts / Memory / MCP / Configuration) in App and Web. App omits the title but the five tabs wrap on a narrow phone, while Configuration retains a desktop two-column list/detail. Each resource has some local push mechanics, but there is no single App-first information hierarchy or depth contract for Claude resources.

This is a **mobile product presentation redesign**, not a redefinition of Claude domain identity/protocol or production implementation approval. Preserve `PRINCIPLE.md`, `docs/design/interaction/app.md` and `#1120`'s conversation-first intent. Related capability work: #3726 Transcript (render every record and per-record Raw), #3600 MCP, #2689 Memory, #3801 Activity provider, #3772 shared MCP UI kit.

### Design decision / information architecture
- **App Workspace host owns exactly one Back/title band** and Terminal-return semantics; Claude supplies content and contextual action(s), not a duplicate App header, Sidebar, global capability dock or terminal capsule.
- **Default Claude App surface is the bound/current conversation**: readable title, compact context/activity information only when verified, timeline and tool rows. No permanent five-tab strip. The conversation reader remains **read-only**; interacting with CLI stays in Terminal. Foreground `claude` presence must not be labeled `working` unless provider-owned Activity confirms it.
- A single **Browse Claude** contextual control opens an App-owned sheet / resource index. It includes **Conversations, Transcripts, Memory, MCP, Configuration** as capability-local resource destinations grouped by work vs tools; no invented Agent selector or separate product-wide navigation.
- Resource views use a single **push/depth stack**: Resource index → collection → detail → raw inspector / file content / MCP tool. Each has one predictable Back, safe-area and independent bounded scrolling; returning restores the origin and reader position.
- **No exact conversation binding:** show an informative empty/current-session state and offer only strict-cwd candidate selection; never auto-claim a candidate as the current conversation. Unavailable/offline/error states have honest labels and local retry only when meaningful.
- Transcript list includes **every** record: known kinds render naturally; unknown/invalid JSON are still visible. Every row offers Raw; no 'recognized/unrecognized' chrome. Raw is pushed above the timeline and provides JSON tree/source toggle.
- MCP: scoped connection inventory and read-only tool inspection are easily reachable; explicit config mutation / one-click Nession setup requires a distinct user confirmation. Configuration retains Project/Global scope **inside** Configuration, then files → file content (no split-grid on App).
- Session/Agent change invalidates source-bound detail, Raw and stale async results and returns to an appropriate Claude root; view swaps keep Terminal mounted.

### Concrete App flow / scenarios
1. Terminal → capsule `+` → Claude Peek → Workspace: current conversation first, host Back → existing Terminal (not remounted).
2. Browse Claude sheet → Conversations list → candidate read-only timeline → Back restores list/scroll.
3. Browse → Transcripts → record → Raw → Back to same record; unknown/malformed record still accessible.
4. Browse → Memory / MCP / Configuration → scoped/detail push → Back, with 375/390/430px widths.
5. Bound/unbound, empty, loading/error/Agent-offline, working vs idle/unknown; all in synthetic prototype fixtures.
6. Accessibility: 44px touch targets, no horizontal tab overflow, focus restoration, history-aware Back, safe-area footer/keyboard overlap, text wrapping.

### Ownership boundaries
- Nession App shell: Workspace layer navigation, page header, depth, back, sheet/safe-area, scroll ownership.
- Claude extension: conversation/transcript/memory/MCP/config content, provider identities, capability-local resources.
- Shared `AIConversation`: transcript/message/resource rendering; Claude only adapts. Do not fork a second App-only conversation parser/renderer.
- Independent Activity: provider-owned states; no `foreground_command` ⇒ `working` guess.
- App vs Web: explicit App composition only; keep Web's master/detail behavior unless a separate decision requires change.

### Prototype
- Decision: **Required**, to test the App navigation/visual hierarchy before production implementation.
- Directory: `claude-app-<this-issue>/` on shared orphan `prototype` branch, interactive HTML with synthetic data and external fixture controls.
- Preview: App 375/390/430px (true-size); walkthroughs must include main conversation, Browse/resource switch, pushed detail, Raw, no-binding, offline, return-to-Terminal. Fidelity limitations and immutable source SHA recorded after source write.
- Publication must not be claimed until matching manifest SHA and HTTPS readback are verified.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 App Claude opens directly to current conversation (when exactly bound), preserves Nession-owned single App header and Terminal continuity, and shows no wrapped multi-tab navigation.
- [ ] SC-02 One unobtrusive Browse entry reaches Conversations, Transcripts, Memory, MCP and Configuration using an App-appropriate sheet/index and common push/back hierarchy, including nested scope/file/tool/Raw details.
- [ ] SC-03 375/390/430px touch widths have correct clipping, scrolling, ≥44px interaction target, safe-area and long-title/Raw handling. Back restores prior selection and reading position.
- [ ] SC-04 Exact/unbound/empty/unavailable/offline/loading/error states are represented honestly; foreground CLI detection never masquerades as authoritative working/idle status; Session changes invalidate stale details without unmounting Terminal.
- [ ] SC-05 Reuse shared AIConversation, Transcript Raw, MCP, Memory and configuration owners; Web presentation is not regressed, and no provider-private data is exposed by the App layer.

### Prototype source and validation (2026-11-17)
- **Source authored:** shared orphan `prototype` branch, `claude-app-3829/` (`index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.js`, `README.md`). Root gallery and catalog linked; unrelated prototype directories preserved.
- **Immutable source pin:** [interactive HTML at `6d53de8707cd0e1c7e07cb3c5e6ea88d814ebb18`](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/6d53de8707cd0e1c7e07cb3c5e6ea88d814ebb18/claude-app-3829/index.html); [scenario/fidelity](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/6d53de8707cd0e1c7e07cb3c5e6ea88d814ebb18/claude-app-3829/README.md); [catalog](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/6d53de8707cd0e1c7e07cb3c5e6ea88d814ebb18/index.html).
- **Mock checks:** JavaScript parsed in V8; four source files readable via connected GitHub; shared frame paths, App width controls, resource route strings and gallery/catalog entries statically checked; all passed. Contains synthetic bound/working/unbound/offline/session-switch fixtures and nested Transcript Raw/MCP/Configuration paths.
- **Remaining unverified:** live App prototype clickthrough, actual iOS/Safari gestures/keyboard and production shell fidelity. **Pages published:** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/claude-app-3829/index.html at prototype SHA `6d53de8707cd0e1c7e07cb3c5e6ea88d814ebb18` as included in the successful sanitized artifact/manifest. Trusted deployment verified the public prototype manifest and its pinned source SHA; independent direct-path HTTPS probe for this specific Claude HTML was unavailable from this chat environment.
- **Design status:** concept review ready; production implementation and acceptance remain Pending. Existing #1120/#3726/#3600/#2689/#3772 prototypes remain the specialized feature sources, not superseded as data/behavior contracts.
### Pages publication correction (2026-11-18)
- Initial [Deploy / Public Pages #44122614232](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/44122614232) failed in `Build sanitized static Pages artifact` because the structured `claude-app-3829/index.html` omitted the required `data-nession-gallery-link` and `data-nession-source-link` annotations; this was an authoring contract violation, **not** a failed prototype change signal.
- Corrected both required attributes on `prototype` commit `6d53de8707cd0e1c7e07cb3c5e6ea88d814ebb18`; gallery/source anchors now match `pages/scripts/publish-prototypes.mjs` regex exactly (one each). New publication/readback still pending until successful `Deploy / Public Pages` and manifest SHA evidence. Do not treat the earlier failure as resolved solely from this code change.
